lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six high-luminance circular spots arranged in two irregular horizontal rows on the lateral surface of the caudal peduncle.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal keel running along the lateral midline of the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient from high-luminance dorsal reflection to deep ventral shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch and tissue loss at the ventral tip of the lower caudal lobe; multiple small, high-intensity white punctate marks on the trailing edge of the upper caudal lobe.
